purpose: Activities change participation structure around worthwhile mapped Algebra work. They are not required to consume Practice 2/3 Bank routes.
content_source: Use the exact Assessment Plan + Question Structure + canonical Bank items/figures when useful. Purpose-author or adapt middle-practice questions when that creates a better activity without inventing new assessed content.

projection: Desmos Activity when a real link/source exists
handout: Tarsia when an approved route exists

question_set_rule: Choose a classroom-sized set that fits the activity and learning job. No fixed 24-question Practice 2/Practice 3 routing is authoritative now.
source_exclusions: official Exit Ticket evidence as ordinary practice material
closure: Optional formative closure only when useful/requested; do not append a fake official Exit Ticket.
student_metadata: No visible Bank IDs, I Can codes, DOK, structure IDs, or authoring metadata.
